history.reason: First acceptance of N18 (model/validation/st2_product.py --replay, protocol in its docstring before running): B's post-prior detections mapped to clip pixels (0 dropped) and replayed through track.run with the product's clicked calibration and no A prior, on N6's 7 sequences, stride-2 frames, n=1. It scores level with B, so the ~6 m homography costs the tracker about nothing and A's loss is the scene prior.

CORRECTION to the previous N18 reason, values unchanged: it said 'the ~6 m homography costs the tracker about nothing and A's loss is the scene prior'. A review found N18 alone does not attribute A's loss (its detections are B's, filtered by a good prior on a different canvas), and the association interval (AssA -0.003, 95% CI about +-0.022, n=7) is as wide as the stitch's whole measured worth: no cost is DETECTABLE, which is weaker. N19 is the attribution.

First acceptance of N19 (model/validation/st2_product.py --n19; protocol and PASS RULE written into model-map (not published) §3 N19 before any arm ran). One no-prior detection pass per sequence, then the scene prior applied offline through track.make_prior(gates=...) from the product's clicked calibration, four pre-registered arms (n=4), replayed: v0 both gates (the shipped prior - it reproduces tracker.*.p05.common7 exactly, which is the consistency check), v1 none, v2 pitch polygon only, v3 height gate only. Under the rule, v2 is BETTER (HOTA up on 7 of 7, and precision UP not down); v1 fails it on precision; v3 is indistinguishable from v0, so the height gate is doing all of the damage and the polygon is buying the precision.

INTENDED: the shipped scene prior lost its height gate (N19/N20), and product.detect.* score WITH the prior, so both rise - recall_m 0.6330 -> 0.6341, recall_px 0.8295 -> 0.8318. Small because this is the 118575 job's 65-point vendor remap, a GOOD calibration, where N20 measures the gate as removing little; on the operator's ~6 m clicked map N19 measures it removing a third of the boxes. detsweep.score now calls track.make_prior instead of a hand-copied gate list, so this number follows the product by construction.

history.reason: First acceptance of N20 (model/validation/st2_product.py --n20; protocol and PASS RULE in its docstring and model-map (not published) §3 N20 before any arm ran). N19's four arms again on the GOOD calibration - B's remap, on B's canvas, one no-gate detection pass then the same offline gates - to answer what N19 could not: does the height gate earn its keep when the camera is recovered from a fit that is RIGHT? Rule: it does iff v0 beats v2 on HOTA on >=6 of 7. It won on 1 of 7. So the gate loses on a bad calibration (largely) and on a good one (slightly), there is no threshold to find, and it is off by default as of this commit. v0 reproduces tracker.*.p05m.common7 exactly, which is the consistency check.

N10/N11 re-measured both on the PRODUCT config (9 STC2025 clips, coreml r576 conf 0.5 stride 2, metric stitch) instead of one job directory whose tracks predate the current tracker.
